USE db_gold_powerbi;
GO

CREATE OR ALTER VIEW vw_dim_cliente AS
SELECT * FROM OPENROWSET(
    BULK 'gold/dim_cliente/',
    DATA_SOURCE = 'GoldDataLake',
    FORMAT = 'DELTA'
) AS rows;
